the quality of NMR protein structures.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of the recalculations is good, and that the recalculated structures can be considered to be of comparable quality to the structures in the original PDB.
the quality of the structures in the PDB is generally good and that the quality indicators are generally consistent across all structures.
the recalculated structures are generally of better quality than the original ones, but the improvement is not dramatic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we recalculated the structures of more than 500 proteins and that the recalculated structures are of higher quality than the original structures.
the quality of NMR solution structures has been improved significantly by recalculating the coordinates with the help of restraints from the FRED database.
the RECOORD project has produced a set of recalculated structures that can be used as a reference database for quality assessment and structural modeling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of NMR structures is not a function of the number of re­straints per residue.
it is possible to obtain a database of NMR structures with good quality, as measured by a variety of criteria, if the original structures were not too bad.
the quality of NMR structures is highly variable, and it is not possible to judge their quality by a simple inspection of a few quality indicators.
